component.name: F-Term
component.summary: Chat client for F-Chat, the F-List chat

description.p: F-Term is a client for F-Chat that runs in a terminal or in its own window. It covers the features of the official client: channels and private rooms, private messages, ads, dice, statuses, profiles, friends and bookmarks, chat logs, character search and moderator commands.
It also shows F-List notes and site messages, plays animated eicons and shows how well your kinks match a profile.
